# Manage cash and treasury reserves

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When operating cash, currencies or deposit concentration exceed the team's informal cash-management process. An approved cash policy and reconciled liquidity schedule with authorized account and counterparty limits.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Forecast cash availability and obligations

agent-runnable


Reconcile bank balances, restricted cash, collections, payroll, taxes and debt commitments by currency and date. Distinguish forecast receipts from cleared funds and show the downside liquidity case.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve liquidity and counterparty constraints

human · human approval required


Finance leadership agrees the operating buffer, permitted accounts or instruments, concentration limits and approval rights. Get qualified advice for deposit protection, investment suitability, tax and currency risks in the relevant jurisdictions.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare a treasury action proposal

agent-runnable


Compare the proposed allocations against forecast obligations, access restrictions, fees and settlement timing. Show how cash would be accessed during an outage or counterparty failure without assuming instant liquidity.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Authorize specific treasury transactions

human · human approval required


The designated approvers review account ownership, counterparties and exact amounts before any transfer or investment. Authorized operators execute through the company payment process and retain independent confirmations.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile positions and review liquidity

agent-runnable


Match transactions and balances to statements, refresh the cash forecast and flag limit breaches. Assign corrective actions and reassess the policy when funding, currencies or operating exposure change.

- Verify: An approved cash policy and reconciled liquidity schedule with authorized account and counterparty limits.
- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)
